summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion found one unusually direct US-listed niche hardware supplier, one diversified but obvious utility-hardware leader, and two underfollowed engineered-structure suppliers that sit adjacent to tower-line components. The cleanest underfollowed chokepoint candidate is Preformed Line Products because its public-company exposure maps directly to line hardware, fittings, anchoring, and transmission/distribution accessories. Hubbell is a reference leader rather than an alpha-discovery name because its Power Systems franchise is broad and well-known. Valmont and Arcosa are not fittings pure-plays, but their utility structures businesses are directly exposed to the same transmission buildout bill of materials and procurement cycle. Expanded the US-listed universe around transmission hardware and tower-line components. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is PLPC, which maps to engineered line hardware, fittings, insulators, spacer dampers, and utility inspection services. Adjacent structural-component suppliers ACA and VMI map to utility poles, lattice/tubular structures, and grid-hardening infrastructure. HUBB is included as a reference leader because its Utility Solutions segment has direct T&D components exposure but the company is larger and more diversified. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation. Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around transmission hardware and tower-line components with a two-lane funnel.
